나이.x: Excuse me, but may I ask how old you are?
나이.e: Koreans often ask your 나이 early because it decides who speaks politely to whom.
나이.t: Age matters in Korea because it decides speech level. For elders, use 연세: 연세가 어떻게 되세요?

결혼.t: 'Marry someone' uses 와/과 or 하고, not 을/를: 친구하고 결혼했어요. Pronounced [겨론].

호텔.x: We stayed at a hotel near the sea.

계란.x: I eat two eggs every morning.
계란.t: 달걀 is the native synonym. 계 is usually pronounced [게].

에서.forms: place + 에서 + action verb (식당에서 먹어요) · starting point (집에서 학교까지)
에서.m: at, in (where an action happens); from
에서.x: I meet my friend at a café.
에서.e: 집에서 먹어요 = I eat at home.
에서.t: 어디에서 왔어요? = 'Where are you from?' Here 에서 means 'from'.

담배.ex: 아버지는 건강 때문에 담배를 끊기로 하셨어요.
담배.x: My father decided to quit smoking for his health.
담배.e: Probably from Portuguese 'tabaco', which reached Korea through Japan.

모임.ex: 매달 첫째 토요일에 대학교 친구들 모임이 있어요.
모임.x: I have a get-together with college friends on the first Saturday of every month.
모임.e: Noun from 모이다 'to gather' + -ㅁ: literally 'a gathering'.

소개하다.ex: 오늘은 제가 우리 가족을 한 명씩 소개하겠습니다.
소개하다.x: Today I'll introduce my family members one by one.

안다.m: to hug, to hold (in one's arms)
안다.ex: 엄마가 우는 아기를 꼭 안아 주었어요.
안다.x: The mom held the crying baby tight.
안다.e: Homonym warning: 안다 is also 알다 'know' with -ㄴ다; 안기다 = be hugged.
안다.t: Pronounced [안따]; don't mix it up with 앉다 'to sit', also pronounced [안따].

또한.forms: 또한 at the start or middle of a sentence; casual equivalent: 또
또한.ex: 이 식당은 음식이 맛있고 또한 가격도 싸요.
또한.x: This restaurant's food is tasty, and the prices are also cheap.
또한.e: Built on 또 'again, also'; a more formal, written-style version.
또한.t: 또한 sounds formal; in everyday speech people usually just say 또 or use -도.

문화.x: I'm very interested in Korean culture.
문화.e: Literally 'transformed by writing' — civilization and culture.

비밀.ex: 이건 우리 둘만의 비밀이니까 아무한테도 말하지 마세요.
비밀.x: This is a secret between us two, so don't tell anyone.
비밀.e: Both syllables mean 'hidden, close' — a secret.
비밀.t: Keep a secret with 지키다: 비밀을 지켜 주세요 'Please keep it secret.'

해결.ex: 이 문제는 생각보다 해결이 쉽지 않아요.
해결.x: This problem isn't as easy to solve as I thought.

제품.x: This product was made in a Korean factory.
제품.t: 제품 stresses something manufactured; 상품 stresses goods for sale.

의무.ex: 한국 남자들은 군대에 갈 의무가 있어요.
의무.x: Korean men have a duty to serve in the military.

관련되다.m: to be related, to be connected
관련되다.ex: 이 일은 제 전공과 관련되어 있어요.
관련되다.x: This job is related to my major.

대단하다.ex: 혼자서 그 일을 다 하다니 정말 대단해요.
대단하다.x: It's really impressive that you did all that by yourself.
대단하다.t: 대단해요! is a common compliment when someone achieves something hard.

자세하다.x: Please explain the directions in detail.
자세하다.e: Literally 'careful and fine': down to the small details.
자세하다.t: The adverb 자세히 is very common: 자세히 보세요 'look closely'.

월말.x: It's the end of the month, so there's a lot of work at the office.

단계.ex: 이 프로젝트는 아직 첫 단계에 있어요.
단계.x: This project is still at the first stage.

출금.ex: 현금 출금은 저쪽 기계에서 하시면 됩니다.
출금.x: You can withdraw cash at that machine over there.

재치.ex: 그 친구는 재치가 있어서 대화가 늘 재미있어요.
재치.x: That friend is witty, so talking with them is always fun.
재치.e: Literally 'talent that hits the mark' at just the right moment.
재치.t: Usually used as 재치(가) 있다 'to be witty' or 재치 있는 대답 'a witty reply'.

사치.ex: 비싼 가방을 여러 개 사는 것은 사치예요.
사치.x: Buying several expensive bags is an extravagance.

빈곤.ex: 아직도 많은 아이들이 빈곤 속에서 살고 있습니다.
빈곤.x: Many children are still living in poverty.
빈곤.t: 빈곤 is formal and written; in conversation 가난 is more common.

드러나다.m: to be revealed, to come out, to show
드러나다.ex: 시간이 지나면서 그 사건의 진실이 드러났어요.
드러나다.x: As time passed, the truth about the incident came out.
드러나다.t: 드러나다 means something comes out by itself; 드러내다 means someone reveals it.

출혈.x: The bleeding was bad, so I went straight to the hospital.

신입생.x: In March, the campus fills up with freshmen.
신입생.t: Korean school years start in March, so that's when 신입생 arrive.

합창단.x: I was in the choir when I was in college.

비관.ex: 한 번 실패했다고 너무 비관하지 마세요.
비관.x: Don't despair just because you failed once.

협동심.ex: 이 게임은 협동심이 없으면 이길 수 없어요.
협동심.x: You can't win this game without team spirit.

괜히.forms: 괜히 + verb (괜히 왔다); 괜히 ~았/었어요 = I shouldn't have
괜히.m: for no reason, needlessly; (I) shouldn't have
괜히.x: I washed my car for nothing, and now it's raining.
괜히.t: 괜히 + past tense expresses regret: 괜히 말했어요 = 'I shouldn't have said it.'

거주.x: Do you currently reside in Seoul?
거주.t: Formal: forms and news use 거주하다, but in conversation just say 살다.

페이.m: mobile pay, digital wallet (paying by phone)
페이.ex: 지갑을 안 가져와서 휴대폰 페이로 계산했어요.
페이.x: I didn't bring my wallet, so I paid with mobile pay on my phone.
페이.e: From English 'pay'. Korean payment services are named '…페이', so 페이 alone came to mean paying by phone.
페이.t: Casual. Ask 페이 돼요? 'Can I pay by phone?'. 페이 is also slang for wages: 페이가 세다 'the pay is good'.

하긴.forms: Short for 하기는 · 하긴 그렇네요 · 하긴 그래 (casual)
하긴.m: well, true (admitting a point), come to think of it
하긴.x: Well, it's the weekend, so it makes sense that it's crowded.
하긴.e: Short for 하기는 'as for doing (it)': admitting the other side has a point.
하긴.t: Used when you think again and agree: A: 오늘 춥네요. B: 하긴, 벌써 12월이니까요. Spoken style.

공직자.x: Public officials must work for the people.
공직자.e: -자 = person who does it: 공직자, 과학자, 운전자.
공직자.t: 공직자 includes elected and appointed officials, while 공무원 usually means career civil servants.

시사하다.m: to suggest, to imply, to hint at
시사하다.ex: 이번 선거 결과는 우리에게 많은 것을 시사합니다.
시사하다.x: This election result suggests a lot to us.
시사하다.e: Literally 'show and prompt' — pointing toward something without saying it outright.
시사하다.t: Don't confuse it with the noun 시사 'current affairs', as in 시사 프로그램.

자본주의.x: In a capitalist society, market competition is important.
자본주의.t: Pronounced [자본주이] — 의 in a non-first syllable usually sounds like 이.

화두.m: hot topic, key issue, main theme of discussion
화두.ex: 요즘 인공지능이 사회의 가장 큰 화두입니다.
화두.x: These days, AI is society's biggest topic of discussion.
화두.e: Originally a Zen Buddhist term for a meditation riddle; now 'the topic at the head of the talk'.

군주.x: King Sejong is famous as a monarch who loved his people.

고갈되다.m: to be depleted, to run dry, to be exhausted
고갈되다.ex: 이대로 가면 석유 자원이 곧 고갈될 거예요.
고갈되다.x: If things go on like this, oil resources will soon run out.
고갈되다.e: Literally 'withered and parched', like a dried-up well.
고갈되다.t: Used for resources, funds or ideas: 아이디어가 고갈되다 'to run out of ideas'.

판로.ex: 농민들은 온라인으로 새로운 판로를 찾고 있어요.
판로.x: Farmers are finding new sales channels online.
판로.t: Pronounced [팔로] — ㄴ becomes ㄹ next to ㄹ; collocation 판로를 개척하다 'open up a market'.

잔존하다.m: to remain, to linger, to survive (as a remnant)
잔존하다.ex: 토양에 잔존하는 농약이 건강에 해로울 수 있어요.
잔존하다.x: Pesticide remaining in the soil can be harmful to health.
잔존하다.e: Literally 'leftover existing' — what is still there after the rest is gone.

긴요하다.ex: 지금 우리에게 가장 긴요한 것은 시간이에요.
긴요하다.x: What is most essential to us right now is time.
긴요하다.t: Flip the syllables and you get 요긴하다 'handy, useful', a more everyday word.

깍듯하다.x: He always greets his seniors very politely.
깍듯하다.e: Adverb 깍듯이 is common: 깍듯이 대하다 'to treat with great courtesy'.
깍듯하다.t: Pronounced [깍뜨타다]; typical for juniors treating seniors with proper respect.

현실주의.ex: 그는 이상보다 현실주의를 바탕으로 결정을 내려요.
현실주의.x: He makes decisions based on realism rather than ideals.

배치하다.m: to deploy, station; to arrange, place
배치하다.ex: 정부는 국경 지역에 군인들을 추가로 배치했습니다.
배치하다.x: The government deployed additional soldiers to the border area.

유연 근무제.ex: 유연 근무제 덕분에 아이를 학교에 데려다줄 수 있어요.
유연 근무제.x: Thanks to flextime, I can take my child to school.
유연 근무제.t: An umbrella term for flexible start and finish times (시차 출퇴근제) and similar arrangements, sometimes including 재택근무. Often written without spaces: 유연근무제.

비준.ex: 두 나라는 새 무역 협정을 비준했습니다.
비준.x: The two countries ratified the new trade agreement.
비준.e: Literally 'approve and permit': final official sign-off on a treaty.

재의.m: reconsideration (of a vetoed bill), second vote
재의.ex: 거부권이 행사된 법안은 국회에서 재의에 부쳐집니다.
재의.x: A vetoed bill is put to a second vote in the National Assembly.
재의.t: 재의를 요구하다 is the formal way to say the president sends a bill back, in effect a veto.

열역학.ex: 열역학 법칙에 따르면 에너지는 사라지지 않아요.
열역학.x: According to the laws of thermodynamics, energy does not disappear.
열역학.t: Pronounced [열려칵] — ㄴ insertion, then ㄹ assimilation.

탄소섬유.ex: 이 자전거는 탄소섬유로 만들어서 아주 가벼워요.
탄소섬유.x: This bike is very light because it's made of carbon fiber.

문예사조.m: literary movement, trend in literature and art
문예사조.x: Romanticism is a leading literary movement of 19th-century Europe.
문예사조.e: Literally 'currents of thought in literature and art.'

골계.m: the comic, comic humor (as an aesthetic)
골계.ex: 판소리에는 슬픔과 함께 골계의 미가 잘 드러나요.
골계.x: Pansori shows the beauty of the comic as well as sorrow.
골계.e: The first syllable is read 골 here, not its usual reading 활 'slippery'.
골계.t: Mostly in literary criticism: 골계미 'comic beauty', alongside 숭고미, 우아미 and 비장미.

식민통치.x: Korea was under Japanese colonial rule for 35 years.
식민통치.t: Pronounced [싱민통치] — ㄱ becomes ㅇ before ㅁ.

누설하다.ex: 회사 기밀을 누설하면 법적 책임을 져야 합니다.
누설하다.x: If you leak company secrets, you will face legal liability.

형상화하다.m: to embody, to give concrete form to, to depict
형상화하다.x: This work gives concrete form to the pain of war.
형상화하다.e: Literally 'turn into shape and image' — making the abstract visible.
형상화하다.t: Common in art and literary criticism: 고통을 형상화하다 'to portray suffering in concrete form'.

오도하다.ex: 그 광고는 소비자를 오도할 수 있습니다.

침잠하다.m: to immerse oneself (in thought or study); to sink deep
침잠하다.ex: 그는 몇 년 동안 연구에 침잠했습니다.
침잠하다.x: He immersed himself in his research for several years.
침잠하다.e: Literally 'sink and submerge' — going deep into thought, away from the world.

환원하다.m: to give back, to return; to reduce (to a simpler form or in chemistry)
환원하다.ex: 그 기업가는 재산의 절반을 사회에 환원했습니다.
환원하다.x: The entrepreneur gave half of his fortune back to society.
환원하다.e: Literally 'return to the origin' — giving back or restoring.
환원하다.t: 사회에 환원하다 'give back to society' is the classic collocation for philanthropy.

질펀하다.m: soggy, wet and muddy; broad and flat; lavish (of a party)
질펀하다.x: It rained a lot, so the road is soggy and muddy.

합목적성.ex: 모든 행정 절차는 합목적성을 갖춰야 합니다.
합목적성.x: Every administrative procedure must serve its intended purpose.
합목적성.e: Literally 'the quality of fitting the purpose (목적)'.
